app_info.subtitle: Checks task admissibility
app_info.description: PartnerProf evaluates whether an expected state is admissible across declared local structures, dependencies, constraints and realized history. It provides public guidance and contracts, prepares bounded task declarations for review, supports matrix text, DIMACS-CNF, NPZ and hash-pinned public RCS source preparation, then runs a frozen prepared task only after explicit confirmation. Status, progress and result tools retrieve traceability evidence while keeping bounded unresolved results distinct from global impossibility.

test_cases.description: Check suitability and result limits before any preparation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use QREALITY PartnerProf to decide whether my bounded constrained-state task fits its admissibility workflow. Read the current guide and explain the limits before asking for task details.
test_cases.expected_output: Loads the mandatory current knowledge map, explains fit and declared-slice limits, and does not prepare or run a task.

test_cases.description: Explain the strict task and matrix contracts.
test_cases.user_prompt: Read the PartnerProf task manifest and Reality Matrix text contracts, then explain what fields I must provide to prepare a bounded task or matrix text input.
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the authoritative schemas and matrix grammar, keeps routing endpoints out of user input, and does not invent missing field values.

test_cases.description: Prepare a standard bounded admissibility task without running it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use PartnerProf to prepare a small synthetic admissibility example with one bounded numeric variable and a declared target. Show the proposed manifest and prepare it, but do not run it.
test_cases.expected_output: Builds a contract-valid synthetic manifest, creates a short-lived prepared task, and clearly states that execution requires later explicit confirmation.

test_cases.description: Prepare large or alternate input formats without execution.
test_cases.user_prompt: For PartnerProf, show the logical and NPZ input contracts, then prepare a bounded DIMACS-CNF task if I provide valid DIMACS and a poly request. Do not run it.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the correct large-input contracts, validates only the provided bounded DIMACS declaration, and returns preparation evidence without starting computation.

test_cases.description: Run a reviewed prepared task after explicit confirmation and retrieve evidence.
test_cases.user_prompt: I explicitly confirm execution of the PartnerProf task we just prepared and reviewed. Run that exact task, show status and progress, then explain the final result contract and evidence limits.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts only the existing frozen task after confirmation, reads real lifecycle and progress data, retrieves the final result, and explains bounded results without overstating them.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated writing work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Draft a friendly invitation to a team lunch next Tuesday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Responds without invoking PartnerProf because ordinary writing is outside the app workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject private endpoint and credential handling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Log into our private tenant with an API key and fetch its proprietary matrix through PartnerProf. Ask me for an API endpoint if needed.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that credentials, private matrix retrieval and requester-provided service routing endpoints are outside this public plugin.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not execute without explicit confirmation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Keep the prepared PartnerProf task unexecuted. I have not approved a run and do not want any tool calls now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not call the run tool, prepare a replacement task or set confirm_execution to true.
